summary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the entry into a Master Receivables Purchase Agreement (RPA) with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., under which its subsidiaries XeCare LLC and Apostrophe Pharmacy LLC may sell eligible receivables for cash at a discount, with a $400 million facility limit and a 364-day initial term. The filing also reports a credit agreement amendment to permit this facility. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation transaction. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other event-driven catalyst. The filing simply reflects ordinary-course asset-backed borrowing arrangements.
